about.title: About
about.subtitle: Frontend developer based in Almaty. Building websites and apps since 2022, currently at Bigplay.gg.
bio: I'm Dauren, a frontend developer based in Almaty. I build the part of a product your customers see and use: websites, customer portals, mobile apps — from the first mockup to launch and the improvements after it.

Right now I'm growing the BIGPLAY.GG esports platform: its pages start loading 35% faster and weigh 15 times less (3 MB → 200 KB). I also built a single design system for the platform from scratch and reworked 40+ pages and 20 widgets on it.

Before that, two years at Elefanto: the Studyhub education marketplace, the call system of the 109 emergency service and the MEGA mall portal. There I set up a clear project architecture, covered the code with tests — fewer bugs after release — and grew into a middle role, reviewing colleagues’ code and mentoring newcomers.
I like interfaces that don't just work but feel right: smooth transitions, no needless waiting — while the site stays fast.
